hypothesis: Quantify the measured finite-record energy that the declared motion-v2-type c=343 m/s direct-plus-six-first-order-wall-path model confined to this cuboid support interval cannot cover, even with an oracle overall time shift and unrestricted tap amplitudes. This tests a fixed simulator family, not all physical propagation, an algorithm trial, or independent room generalization.

source.embedded_sofa_license: MIT; preserve the original notice separately from the dataset citation and CC-BY-4.0 declaration
source.rights_scope: Only the frozen measured-RIR microset, existing licensed local readers and output evidence under the original notices/attribution. No WSJ speech, new human recordings or training rights are inferred.

dependencies.wall_state_interpretation: Repeated conditions of one cuboid and the same source/array. Tokens follow the original frozen filenames. They are correlated strata, not eleven independent rooms or trials. Do not infer individual-wall causal effects from this microset.
dependencies.known_room_description: All eleven frozen SOFA files contain the same RoomDescription for 020002; retain this inconsistency. RoomTemperature=0 kelvin and RoomVolume=0 are placeholders, not measurements.

metadata.coordinate_interpretation: Frozen ReceiverPosition equals the global microphones tensor in dEchorate_annotations.h5; the upstream exporter writes those global coordinates directly. Do not add ListenerPosition or apply ListenerView/Up again. These echo-calibrated coordinates are audit metadata, not an independent ground truth or a predictor input.

geometry_evidence.reason: EchoTimings/echo_toa/echo_amp are image-source-derived from echo-calibrated geometry. Original bIPS source/mic-to-wall origin is not needed here. The room-wide geometric bound is valid for any interior source/mic positions in the declared cuboid, without selecting a geometry from RIR results.

model.family: direct plus six first-order axis-wall image paths in a cuboid
model.speed_source: Exactly the unchanged motion-v2 MODEL speed 343 m/s. This is the declared simulator family, not a measured physical speed or a universal lower bound. Official dEchorate constants 346.98 m/s remain provenance context only; no speed sensitivity scan.
model.fractional_delay_kernel: unchanged motion-v2 sample(): two adjacent input samples, linear interpolation
model.room_wide_excess_distance_bound: 2 * max(room_dimensions_m), from the triangle inequality for a reflected source
model.amplitudes: unrestricted; the contiguous interval is a relaxation of seven sparse paths

measurement.observation: Unmodified original Data.IR float64 samples at 48000 Hz; existing load_frozen_rirs reads and finite-checks all five channels, then returns the fixed first two. No resampling, gain normalization, convolution or product DSP.
measurement.primary: For each scored RIR h of N samples and fixed L, E=sum(h[n]^2); C=max_{0<=s<=N-L} sum(h[s:s+L]^2)/E; report C and max(0,1-C). The latter is an energy lower bound outside every length-L support interval, including its oracle overall shift. It is not a seven-tap fit or SI-SDR.
measurement.oracle_tie_rule: earliest index attaining the maximum computed window sum
measurement.oracle_interpretation: Declared waveform-dependent best time placement for an energy coverage upper bound only. Never use this start as a direct-path label, transport lag, SI-SDR alignment or candidate selection.
measurement.fixed_window_interpretation: Raw archive sample-zero coordinates only; no early/direct/late acoustic labels are implied.
measurement.absolute_time_origin: UNKNOWN. Data.Delay=0 does not establish physical excitation sample zero after upstream ESS/deconvolution/recording-offset compensation.
measurement.uncovered_energy_interpretation: Can include higher-order/diffuse room response, transducer response, measurement-chain effects, recording noise and finite-record effects. No single-cause attribution or absolute SPL claim.
measurement.short_ir: REJECT if N < L; never pad or resize L
measurement.aggregate: Descriptive min/median/max across the 22 correlated views, with every per-stratum/channel row retained; no confidence interval, independent-n count or threshold-based acoustic PASS.

acceptance.engineering: Exact data/source/metadata, complete 22 rows and independent recomputation required. Semantic negatives must reject corrupted roles, hashes, counts, L, scores, or promotion.
acceptance.scientific: All finite observed values are reportable, including zero missing-energy bounds; there is no favorable numerical threshold or model promotion.
acceptance.failure: Preserve failure.json and partial evidence, exit nonzero, do not create successful result or retry with changed parameters. Any new method/source contract is a distinct future identity.

prohibited: Treat eleven wall states as eleven independent rooms
Use echo-calibrated positions as independent ground truth
Use metadata placeholder temperature as measured c
Fit c/geometry/wall gains/filter length/t0 or select windows after observing IR
Change motion-v2, old source locks, policies, scores or conclusions
Run an AEC/BF/NS/AGC candidate, speech convolution, ASR/KWS or target hardware
Interpret missing energy as purely reverberation or as an acoustic quality PASS
Normalize, resample, repair or overwrite original RIRs
